question: Which institution launched the Self-Help Group - Bank Linkage Programme in 1992-93?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NABARD.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NABARD** (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) is a development financial institution in India that was established in **1982.**
 
• It was set up to promote **rural development and agriculture** in the country.
 
• The **Self-Help Group - Bank Linkage Programme** was launched by NABARD in **1992-93 **to provide financial assistance to self-help groups (SHGs) in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SBI** (State Bank of India) is a **government-owned banking and financial services** company in India.

 
 
• It is the largest bank in the country in terms of **assets, deposits, branches, customers, and employees.**
 
• SBI has been involved in various initiatives to promote **financial inclusion and empower the underprivileged sections** of society, including SHGs.
 
 
 
• **SIDBI** (Small Industries Development Bank of India) is a **government-owned financial institution** that was set up in** 1990** to promote and finance **small-scale industries** in the country.
 
 
• It provides various services and schemes for the development of **micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs)** in India.
 
 
 
• **IDBI** (Industrial Development Bank of India) is a government-owned financial institution that was established in **1964** to provide financial assistance to industrial projects in the country.
 
 
• It was converted into a **commercial bank in 2004** and is now known as IDBI Bank Limited.
 
• IDBI has been involved in various initiatives to **support MSMEs** and **promote entrepreneurship** in India.
